data.title: Privacy Apps Are Having Their Moment
data.summary_raw: The app layer is where crypto privacy is heating up most right now. Here are 7 new releases you can try today.

data.title: White House Crypto Adviser Patrick Witt Steps Down
data.summary_raw: Witt becomes the second executive director of the White House crypto council to leave, following predecessor Bo Hines, who departed for Tether in August 2025.

data.title: Helius CEO Mert Mumtaz Joins NEAR Foundation Council
data.summary_raw: The head of one of Solana's largest infrastructure firms is joining NEAR's governing council as the network expands its push into private, cross-chain markets.

data.title: Ledger Officially Responds to Hardware Wallet Attack
data.summary_raw: The company announces new reseller security measures after criminals implanted hidden components in hardware wallets to steal recovery phrases.
